 Follow live coverage of the 2026 F1 Mexico City Grand Prix!
 Samuel Coop
 1 November 7:55PM
 0 comments 
 0
 Add us as preferred source 
 Article 
 To news overview 
 Follow the 2026 F1 United States Grand Prix live with RacingNews365, as Round 19 of the F1 season takes place!
 Lewis Hamilton will start the race from pole position after securing his first pole for Ferrari, with George Russell starting alongside him on the front row.
 However, a lot of the focus will no doubt be on Kimi Antonelli as he closes in on a maiden championship in F1.
 The 20-year-old needs just ninth place on Sunday to be crowned the youngest champion in F1 history.
 Will it be Antonelli's day, or will there be a further twist in the title tale?
